purpose: verify an end-to-end educational training and release packet on one declared synthetic fixture
model: two-feature binary logistic regression trained from zero initialization
validation_split: report descriptive metrics after fitting; do not update weights
test_split: report descriptive metrics once after fitting; do not select parameters

configuration.tie_rule: score equal to threshold predicts class 0

baseline: predict the most frequent training label; ties resolve to class 0
interpretation_limit: descriptive checks on this deterministic synthetic fixture only; no statistical or real-world inference
release_gate: publish the documented teaching packet; do not approve model deployment
